method: Actual compiled Cocos HUD, automatic native Box2D, configureCalibration([paper, plank, fridge, paper], true), controller.rotate/moveTo/release. No body pose, velocity, type, scale, contacts, stepping, score, or camera mutation. Measurements after normal UI animation settles. World-coordinate area-density products are not engine mass; snapshot mass is native kg.

wood_plank.description: 搭上一块稳固板，上下都踏实一点。

basketball.description: 别担心，有人给它贴了双面胶。

geometryCoverage.current: 150-wide fridge only, three viewports and four quarter-turns, center plus left/right limits
geometryCoverage.paperAndPlank: Prior DIFFICULTY_DIMENSIONS.json remains the full matrix for unchanged paper/plank geometry; these were used as normal setup releases in this current run

harnessCorrection.cause: Two browser requestAnimationFrame callbacks can occur before Cocos paints the latest controller move under concurrent load. This read body transform before Sprite/claw render followed it. Final test waits two actual Director.EVENT_AFTER_DRAW events. No gameplay/frame-rate/physics changes.

visualNotes: Current 150-wide fridge and claw attachment are visible at center and each lateral limit in all twelve tested orientations. No clipped-claw edge poses for the fridge.
Three actual viewport screenshots self-reviewed. Paper/plank world geometry is unchanged; their previous vertical-board edge-claw crop observation is not silently cleared.

readonlyRuntimeReview.contactOffset: Uses real contact manifold separations in Cocos world units, minus .005 metre slop multiplied by PTM32; applies correction only to a joint target along true outward support normal, transformed into base local coordinates. No body transform mutation.
readonlyRuntimeReview.correctionFactor: Both finite-force joint kinds compile cf=0; removes positional feedback, retains finite relative-velocity resistance and existing break/connection limits.
readonlyRuntimeReview.contactAngularDamping: All six current specs use 6 on first actual object contact; when the final native contact ends, restore ordinary1.5 or basketball0.1. Bodies remain dynamic.
readonlyRuntimeReview.findings: No new P1/P2 found in this bounded read-only review. Mechanism-specific native tests belong to physics agent; no claim of full difficulty acceptance.
